title: Negative-pool coverage sweep for learned semantic state addressing
question: How does mean-gradient negative-pool size affect the learned continuous semantic state retriever at a fixed 512-epoch training budget?
hypothesis: H_sweep: the recall gain from broader negative coverage will continue from 1 to 4 to 8 negatives but will eventually saturate or reverse as the negative pool approaches the available training-code population.

arms.name: mean_1
arms.intervention: one deterministic negative per positive update, mean margin gradient

arms.name: mean_4
arms.intervention: four deterministic negatives per positive update, mean margin gradient

arms.name: mean_8
arms.intervention: eight deterministic negatives per positive update, mean margin gradient

arms.name: mean_16
arms.intervention: sixteen deterministic negatives per positive update, mean margin gradient

endpoints.name: target_top1_recall
endpoints.role: primary — correct opaque persistent state selected

endpoints.name: target_rank_mean
endpoints.role: secondary — mean rank of correct target state

endpoints.name: training_updates
endpoints.role: secondary — optimizer updates; fixed across arms

endpoints.name: negative_evaluations_total
endpoints.role: secondary — total negative examples scored during training

endpoints.name: state_build_macs
endpoints.role: audit — one-time cached state embedding arithmetic

decision_rule.licenses: evidence that broader negative coverage continues to materially improve retrieval beyond eight negatives

decision_rule.condition: mean_16 recall is between mean_8 recall - 0.05 and mean_8 recall + 0.10
decision_rule.licenses: evidence of saturation/plateau after eight negatives under this objective
evidence that excessive negative coverage reverses the observed gain on this workload
decision_rule.does_not_license: that broader negatives are generally harmful

held_constant: H=64 task anchor and A1 H-invariant query/state stream
one optimizer update per positive code per epoch
no evaluation address or gold target enters training
prior C5 and learned-state results remain frozen
